summary: Ansible connects as your local username by default; set a different connection user with remote_user in a play, or ansible_user as a host or group variable. Use become to run tasks as another user.
questions: How do I make Ansible log in as a different user?
How do I set ansible_user for a group of hosts?
What's the difference between remote_user and become?

answer_card.title: Set the remote connection user
answer_card.answer_md:
Default is your control-node username. To change it:

Play level:
```yaml
- hosts: webservers
  remote_user: admin
```
Host variable:
```text
other1.example.com ansible_connection=ssh ansible_user=myuser
```
Group variable:
```yaml
cloud:
  hosts: {cloud1: ..., cloud2: ...}
  vars:
    ansible_user: admin
```
To run *tasks* as another user after connecting, use `become`.
